text:
ashley: Need a short call: what exactly can adapters forward when routing from Hosted->Private/Dedicated? main concern: PII and feature flags leaking.
bryan: Current state: we forward `x-rw-trace`, `x-rw-route`, and a freeform `x-customer-meta`. That meta blob sometimes includes `user_hash`, `feature_flags`, `env`. Not good.
mina: Proposal: three-mode model: `minimal`(trace+route only), `ops`(hashed tenant + allowlist meta keys), `debug`(clear tenant+meta, timeboxed + audit).
kevin: Hashing tenant is fine but we must standardize algo and per-deployment salt (sha256 + salt). Salt stored in control plane and rotated quarterly.
ashley: Sealing tenant with control-plane KMS blob is another option for Dedicated where latency budget allows. need perf numbers before recommending.
bryan: For implementation: add `telemetry` block to deployment manifest. example:
```
telemetry:
  profile: minimal|ops|debug
  clear_tenant_allowed: false
  debug_window_mins: 60
  sample_rate_cap: 0.2
```
mina: Default to `ops` with `hashed` tenant for existing deployments. `debug` requires explicit admin grant + MFA + audit event.
kevin: Adapters should call a tiny validation lib from control plane that returns a Decision object: `tenant_mode: hashed|sealed|clear`, `allowed_meta_keys: [...]`, `sample_allow: n`. Cache the decision TTL to survive control-plane outages.
ashley: Fallback if validation unavailable: conservative local policy = `minimal`. document this in runtime README.
bryan: Also require adapters to respect `x-rw-sample` and `x-rw-sample-rate` headers and enforce per-deployment caps. Private customers can set lower caps in manifest.
mina: Security note: forbid forwarding meta keys that match `/user|email|ssn|phone/`. Add fuzz tests that assert no matching keys get forwarded.
kevin: Audit: every time a deployment flips to `debug` or `clear_tenant_allowed=true`, emit immutable audit event with admin id, timestamp, justification, and require MFA. Also auto-revert `debug` after `debug_window_mins`.
ashley: Backcompat: adapters that don't understand new manifest act as `minimal`. Rollout plan: start with ops(hashed) rollout for 2 weeks, canary sealed KMS path on Dedicated.
bryan: Action items: 1) Kevin -> spec for validation lib + cache TTL + salt rotation. 2) Mina -> manifest schema PR + migration notes. 3) Ashley -> perf numbers for KMS seal/unseal and recommended defaults. 4) Bryan -> tests (fuzz + sampling).
audit-bot: Created GH issue ARCH-telemetry-granularity and added to milestone `next-rc`.
nashley: If no objections Ill lock this for the upcoming release window. :thumbsup:
bryan: +1
mina: +1
kevin: +1
